sql.foreach: SELECT #{period.index} AS bucket_index, #{period.startDate} AS start_date, #{period.endDate} AS end_date, #{period.startUtc} AS start_utc, #{period.endUtc} AS end_utc

mapper.select:
SELECT
(#{buckets} - 1) - LEAST(#{buckets} - 1, GREATEST(0, PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(a.timestamp, '%Y%m'))))
(#{buckets} - 1) - LEAST(#{buckets} - 1, GREATEST(0, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(NOW(), a.timestamp) / #{spanDays})))
AS bucket_index, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `call`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'email' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `email`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'meeting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `meeting`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'note' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `note`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) NOT IN ('call', 'email', 'meeting', 'note') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `other`, NULL AS period_start FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
AND a.timestamp <= NOW()
AND a.timestamp >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 11 MONTH)
AND a.timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY bucket_index ORDER BY bucket_index

SELECT boundary.bucket_index, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `call`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'email' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `email`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'meeting' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `meeting`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) = 'note' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `note`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(a.type)) NOT IN ('call', 'email', 'meeting', 'note') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `other`, DATE_FORMAT(boundary.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS period_start FROM () boundary JOIN activity a ON a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.timestamp >= boundary.start_utc AND a.timestamp < boundary.end_utc WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
AND a.timestamp >= #{startUtc} AND a.timestamp < #{endUtc} GROUP BY boundary.bucket_index, boundary.start_date ORDER BY boundary.bucket_index

SELECT touch.user_id, COUNT(*) AS touches FROM ( SELECT a.created_by_id AS user_id FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND a.timestamp <= NOW() UNION ALL SELECT t.assigned_to_id AS user_id FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.assigned_to_id IS NOT NULL AND t.completed = TRUE AND t.updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND t.updated_at <= NOW() UNION ALL SELECT n.author_id AS user_id FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility != 'private' AND n.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND n.created_at <= NOW() ) touch GROUP BY touch.user_id ORDER BY touches DESC, touch.user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.timestamp > NOW() AND a.timestamp <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT FROM activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deal_id = #{dealId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND created_by_id = #{createdById} ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC

SELECT FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (a.person_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person linked_person WHERE linked_person.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND linked_person.id = a.person_id AND linked_person.archived_at IS NULL)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id IN #{id}) ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT FROM activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM activity WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (subject LIKE #{query} OR notes LIKE #{query}) ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
